# BlueTigre

> BlueTigre finds new markets for specialty chemicals a company already makes.
> PROWL (Pattern Recognition Of White-space Leads) is the agentic AI engine that
> reads the public record; a chemist with 30+ years in the industry makes every
> judgement. Operated by Bluetigre Consultants LLC, Okatie, South Carolina.

## What PROWL does
- [How PROWL works](https://bluetigre.com/what-we-do/): the Discover and Qualify stages, the eight kinds of public source, and what a person signs off.

## Evidence
- [Case studies](https://bluetigre.com/case-studies/): two client-anonymous engagements.
- [81 candidate markets, one established chemical](https://bluetigre.com/case-studies/81-candidate-markets-one-chemical/): 39 already served; the top-ranked lead was rejected on its own evidence.
- [A bio-based diol, 51 candidate markets](https://bluetigre.com/case-studies/bio-based-diol-51-markets/): 9 already served; 14 of 114 players in the top category buy rather than make.

## Limits worth quoting accurately
- PROWL does not size markets and does not rank commercial attractiveness. A high score means a market is well supported by evidence, not that it is attractive.
- Every fact carries its source and the date it was read. The machine drafts; a person signs.
- "We looked and found nothing" and "we could not look" are reported as different facts.
